scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser

scripts.test:audio: playwright test tests/browser/soundscape-lab.spec.ts && playwright test tests/browser/soundscape-lab.spec.ts --browser=firefox
scripts.test:uwb: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/uwb-position.test.ts tests/uwb-bridge.test.ts && playwright test tests/browser/uwb.spec.ts tests/browser/uwb-live.spec.ts tests/browser/uwb-device.spec.ts
